fichas.title: Sprinkler Systems
fichas.summary: Automatically actuated fire-fighting systems consist of regularly spaced closed sprinklers connected to permanently installed, pressurised pipework. The page describes wet, dry, rapid-reaction dry, tandem, and pre-action systems; sprinkler types and spray patterns; applications; design factors; and example fire-hazard-class water quantities and effective areas. Pipework should remain exposed or be concealed only by a suspended ceiling to enable repair and maintenance.
